Read the first row of the list.

Step Expected: The list reloads with the h1 Customers.

Step Expected: The first row differs from the one on page 1.

Step Expected: The detail page opens with its heading.

Step Action: Select the year named in the row from the year dropdown.

Step Expected: The h1 matches the heading in the row.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
